blocks.content: Blood relation questions test your ability to decode family relationships from given clues. These questions appear 2–3 times in  CGL Tier 1. The key is to draw a family tree diagram for every question.

cells:
PATERNAL SIDE: Father's father = Paternal Grandfather | Father's mother = Paternal Grandmother

Father's brother = Uncle (Paternal) | Father's sister = Aunt (Paternal)

Father's brother's son/daughter = Cousin

MATERNAL SIDE: Mother's father = Maternal Grandfather | Mother's mother = Maternal Grandmother

Mother's brother = Uncle (Maternal) | Mother's sister = Aunt (Maternal)

SIBLINGS: Brother | Sister | Half-brother | Half-sister

SPOUSE: Husband | Wife | Father-in-law | Mother-in-law | Brother-in-law | Sister-in-law

CHILDREN: Son | Daughter | Nephew (brother's son) | Niece (brother's daughter)

GRAND: Grandson | Granddaughter | Great-grandfather | Great-grandmother

blocks.content: Use the following symbols to draw family trees quickly: + for male, ○ for female, = for married couple, | for parent-child, — for siblings.

cells: NOTE: SHORTCUT: When solving blood relation problems, ALWAYS draw a diagram. Never try to solve mentally — errors increase dramatically without a visual tree.

blocks.content: Ex.1 Pointing to a woman, Ram said, 'She is the daughter of my grandfather's only son.' How is the woman related to Ram?
Sol. Grandfather's only son = Ram's father. Daughter of Ram's father = Ram's sister. Ans: Sister
Ex.2 A is B's brother. C is A's mother. D is C's father. E is B's son. How is D related to E?
Sol. Draw: D→C (father-daughter), C→A,B (mother-children), B→E (parent-child). D is C's father → D is A and B's grandfather → D is E's great-grandfather. Ans: Great-grandfather
Ex.3 Introducing a man, a woman says 'His mother is the only daughter of my mother.' How is the man related to the woman?
Sol. Only daughter of woman's mother = the woman herself. So the man's mother is the woman. Therefore the man is the woman's son. Ans: Son
Ex.4 P is Q's brother. R is Q's mother. S is R's father. T is S's wife. How is P related to T?

Sol. T is S's wife → S and T are couple. R is S's child (R is Q's mother, S is R's father). P and Q are siblings (P is Q's brother), and R is their mother. So T is S's wife and S is R's father → T is R's mother → T is P's grandmother. Ans: Grandson (P is T's grandson)
Ex.5 X's mother is Y's sister. Z is Y's mother's husband. How is X related to Z?

Sol. Z is Y's mother's husband → Z is Y's father. Y is X's mother's sibling (sister). So Z and X's mother are siblings' parents → Z is X's maternal grandfather. Ans: Grandson/Granddaughter (X is Z's grandchild)
In coded blood relation questions, relationships are represented by symbols like +, −, ×, ÷, @, #, etc. A key is given, and you must decode the relationship chain.

cells:
A + B → A is the father of B

A − B → A is the mother of B

A × B → A is the brother of B

A ÷ B → A is the sister of B

A @ B → A is the husband of B

A # B → A is the daughter of B

blocks.content: Ex.6 (Coded) Using above key: P + Q − R × S. How is P related to S?
Sol. P+Q → P is father of Q. Q−R → Q is mother of R. R×S → R is brother of S. So P→Q→R→S. P is father of Q (mother of R). So P is grandfather of R (and S). Ans: P is grandfather of S
Q.25 Pointing to a photograph, a man says, 'She is the daughter of my son.' How is the girl in the photograph related to the man?
Ans: (a) Granddaughter Hint: His son's daughter = his granddaughter.
Q.26 A is B's father. C is A's sister. D is C's husband. How is D related to B?
Ans: (a) Uncle Hint: C is A's sister → C is B's aunt. D is C's husband → D is B's uncle.
Q.27 If A + B means A is mother of B, and A × B means A is father of B, and A − B means A is sister of B, in the expression P × Q + R − S, how is P related to S?
Ans: (a) Grandfather Hint: P×Q: P is father of Q. Q+R: Q is mother of R. R−S: R is sister of S. P→Q(father)→R(mother). P is grandfather of R and R is sister of S → P is grandfather of S.
Q.28 Introducing a boy, a girl says 'He is the son of the daughter of the father of my uncle.' How is the boy related to the girl?
Ans: (a) Brother Hint: Father of my uncle = grandfather. Daughter of grandfather = mother/aunt. If daughter = girl's mother, then boy is her mother's son = her brother.
